adoration.text: Adoration Room: Weekdays 07:00-22:00; weekends 07:00-20:00; public holidays 09:00-17:00. Closed Mondays 09:00-14:00 for cleaning; on 1st Mondays 09:00-16:00.

confession.text: Confession at L2 Confessionals, 30 minutes before all weekend Masses when a priest is available.

devotions.text: Rosary 40 minutes before weekday evening and weekend Masses.
Divine Mercy Devotion every Tuesday 20:00 in the Adoration Room.
Holy Hour with Reparation every 1st Thursday 20:00 in the Church Hall.
Holy Hour with Reparation every 1st Friday 20:00 in the Church Hall.
St Thérèse Intercessory on Mon, Wed, Fri 15:00 in L3 Room 3.4.
Charismatic Prayer Community every Thursday 20:00 in L3 Auditorium.
